name: quota-matata
description: Quota Matata — no worries, just retries. Quota-aware retry plugin for OpenCode v2 (Alibaba Coding Plan and generic providers).

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const d='dist-test/test';const n=fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.test.js')).length:0;if(!n){console.error('test gate: no compiled *.test.js files under '+d+' (did tsc emit?); refusing to pass with zero tests');process.exit(1)}" && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
